mediator_rule.unresolved: unseen or donor-inconsistent signature remains UNRESOLVED

graph_analysis.object: directed dynamic multigraph over exact 64-bit full keys
graph_analysis.replacement_edges: resident full key -> committed new full key in same physical slot

graph_analysis.off_on_test: exact edge-multiset equality and graph-invariant deltas; no graph similarity threshold

claim_ceiling: Full-key shadow state is an instrumentation witness for the instrumented single-thread executions, not a claim about unobserved production executions.
Replacement edges identify physical-slot replacement events in the traced measurement search; they do not by themselves identify downstream search-value causality.
Mediator sufficiency is tested only for the frozen five-coordinate signature and fresh 80k law cells.
Cross-engine graph comparison is descriptive unless an explicit intervention correspondence is separately established.
